name: Homebrew

knownPaths.description: Downloaded bottles and formula metadata kept so a reinstall or upgrade does not re-download. Safe to clear: installed packages are unaffected and stay installed, and brew fetches again on demand.
knownPaths.inventoryDescription: downloads/ holds the bottle archives themselves. The JSON files beside it are cached formula indexes.

knownPaths.description: Per-formula build logs from source builds. Read these when a brew install failed.

description: Homebrew package manager. Only its download cache is disposable; the installed packages live under the prefix, not here.
